title: LLM-driven creation of natural hazard geodatabase from digital mass media
summary: HSE reports an operational pipeline that extracted a 38,000-event natural-hazard database from eight million Russian-language articles.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: HSE University uses a language model to identify, structure, and geocode natural-hazard reports. Its first phase reportedly processed eight million articles and produced 38,000 event entries covering Russia in 2018–2024. The research resource exists, while transfer to additional users and resulting emergency-management benefits remain prospective.
purpose: Turn fragmented news reports into usable geospatial hazard information.
system: LLM-driven creation of natural hazard geodatabase from digital mass media

ratings.reason: HSE reports an operational LLM pipeline that created an actively updated 38,000-event geodatabase from eight million articles, a concrete research resource.
No emergency decision, loss reduction, or avoided disaster is attributed to the database.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 5: LLM-driven creation of natural hazard geodatabase from digital mass media

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: An LLM builds a 38,000-event natural-hazard database
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
